item.title: Terri Sewell on 'rogue actions' of ICE agents: 'Minneapolis today could be Birmingham tomorrow'
item.description: U.S. Rep. Terri Sewell (D-Birmingham) is calling for the Department of Homeland Security to face an independent investigation following the fatal shootings of two agitators by ICE agents in Minneapolis.
